title: SecureHomes Randomized Clinical Trial
official: A Randomized Clinical Trial of the VA Secure Homes Lethal Means Intervention for Veterans With Elevated Suicide Risk
summary: Firearm suicide prevention is a leading VA priority. To date, no intervention has been shown to encourage Veterans with elevated suicide risk to adopt secure firearm storage practices to reduce their suicide risk. The proposed effort will test whether the SecureHomes intervention can encourage Veterans with elevated suicide risk to adopt secure firearm storage practices, such as voluntarily removing firearms from their households or securing them with locking devices.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Firearms on premises (assessed via Mental Illness Research, Education, and Clinical Center Lethal Means Safety measure)
2. Owns at least one of the firearms on premises (assessed via Mental Illness Research, Education, and Clinical Center Lethal Means Safety measure)
3. Has ACCESS to at least one of the firearms on premises (definition below, via Mental Illness Research, Education, and Clinical Center Lethal Means Safety measure)
4. Recent VHA ED/UC, PC, OMH encounter who screen positive on the C-SSRS Screener (definition below) - (determined via recruitment database)

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Severely cognitively impaired
2. Lack decisional capacity
3. Are unable to provide consent
4. Lack phone access
5. Are currently admitted to the hospital
6. Have a drug use disorder with current use (other than marijuana)
7. Have alcohol use disorder with daily intake
8. Participated in the SecureHomes pilot study
